additional_info.body:
Hello,
Valerio is speaking.
The spare parts is not that one mentioned in the ticket.
The issue is the "halo" effect, as described in the Q-feedback Q2411
Sicharge D- Controlpanel "Halo" Effect
.
Therefore, the spare parts that must to be order should be the below ones:
1x
8EM5903-0AA04-0AA0
8EM5905-0AA00-8AA
Please,  check the picture that we shared and confirm it.
Thank you very much,
Valerio Filocamo
